latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image to Video Benchmark skill — Initial release:

- Instantly converts still images to video clips using AI, benchmarking results against other tools.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC formats up to 200MB.
- Automated session and token setup; 100 free credits for new users.
- Streamlined cloud processing with easy download of 1080p MP4 videos.
- Simple workflows for uploading, editing, and exporting videos for researchers, creators, and marketers.
